怎么开始转换？: How do I convert a dictionary?
选择一个或多个同格式文件，确认输入与输出格式，然后点击“开始转换”。纯 TXT: Choose one or more files in the same format, select the input and output formats, then choose “Convert dictionary”. For TXT with one word per line, select “Word list” and enable Pinyin generation when the target format requires codes.
不会。转换通过 WebAssembly 在你的浏览器本地进行。网络仅用于加载网站: No. WebAssembly converts files locally in your browser. Network requests only load the website and engine assets; dictionary contents are never sent to a server. Save your downloads before closing the page.
为什么没有转换出词条？: Why are there no exported entries?
请确认输入格式与文件内容匹配。TXT 没有拼音，转 Rime 等格式时需要生成编: Check that the selected input format matches the file contents. Plain TXT has no Pinyin, so formats such as Rime may need code generation. Restrictive filters can also remove all entries. Some formats remain unverified; check the result messages.
有哪些已知兼容性限制？: What compatibility limits should I know about?
Big5 输入存在上游解码问题；Gboard ZIP 需要先解压，文本与二进制词: Big5 input has an upstream decoding issue. Extract Gboard ZIP backups and choose the correct text or binary format. Rime output has no YAML metadata header. Formats such as SCEL may not preserve all original frequencies. Review your results.
手机可以转换大词库吗？: Can I convert large dictionaries on my phone?
小型词库可在手机浏览器处理。大型词库会占用较多内存，超过 10 MB 时建议拆分: Small dictionaries can be processed in a mobile browser. Large files use more memory; above 10 MB, use smaller batches or a computer. The combined input limit is 50 MB, and completion depends on your device.
让每一个好词，都有新去处。: A new home for every good word.
只调整你需要的选项，其余保留原词库设置。: Adjust only what you need. Other settings preserve the original dictionary.
英文前加下划线: Prefix Latin words with an underscore
自定义映射表（UTF-8，每行：汉字 ⇥ 编码）: Custom mapping (UTF-8, each line: character ⇥ code)
规则以逗号分隔；单字也需设置规则，例如 code_e1=p11+p12+p13+: Separate rules with commas. Single characters also need a rule, such as code_e1=p11+p12+p13+p14. Entries without a matching rule will not receive codes.
部分格式采用固定编码及排序，可能忽略相关设置；Rime 固定按词频降序。Big5: Some formats use fixed encoding and sorting and may ignore these settings. Rime always sorts by descending frequency. Big5 input has a known decoding issue.
沿用引擎规则，例如 213 ,nyyy：词语、拼音（空格分隔）、词频。: Uses the engine rule syntax, for example 213 ,nyyy: word, Pinyin (space-separated), frequency.

引擎提供 54 种导入格式与 46 种导出格式。以下常见格式已有特定样例验证，实: The engine provides 54 import formats and 46 export formats. These common formats have specific tested samples; compatibility still depends on the file contents and conversion direction.

一次选择最多 100 个同格式文件，总计不超过 50 MB。可合并输出，或逐个转: Choose up to 100 files in the same format, up to 50 MB combined. Merge them or convert separately and download a ZIP. Above 10 MB, use smaller batches or a computer.
生成拼音、五笔等编码，进行简繁转换，按词长和词频过滤，移除字符，或调整排序与词频: Generate Pinyin, Wubi, and other codes. Convert Chinese scripts, filter by length and frequency, remove characters, or change sorting and frequency. Defaults preserve the source settings without automatic deduplication.
转换完成后检查预览和提示，再导入目标输入法。你也可以在 iPhone 上使用支持: Check the preview and messages before importing into your target input method. On iPhone, try DDUP, a keyboard that supports Sogou and text dictionary imports.
